- **Bluesky:** passes. I skipped the advisory suggestions pass, and the file has no `### Suggestions (advisory)` section. I judged the copy myself and had no notes for it.

I skipped the separate sub-agent critique of the repaired copy, so the fixes were checked only by my own reading.

The file has the orienting note, the two repaired posts collapsed in `<details>`, the CTA lines and the footer.
